comments: 0.74 is deduced from |s{-n}=2.74 b {I8} (2018MuZZ) compared to the normalization given in 1970Mu15 based on |s{-n}=2.03 b {I41}. Additional uncertainty introduced by the latest cross section is negligible. However, one gets normalization factors of 0.88 {I7} for |S(I(|g+ce) out of capture state)=100 and 1.04 {I10} for |S(I(|g+ce) to g.s.)=100 with respect to |s{-n}=2.74 b {I8} (2018MuZZ). Absolute elemental cross section data from 2007ChZX (Budapest measurements) are inconsistent with these factors; they imply normalization factors that vary widely from one transition to another and are typically at least an order of magnitude larger. New measurements are called for in order to resolve these normalization discrepancies. Note that forty four gammas are not placed in the level scheme.
